items.summary_en: ung220z-tool is a one-click credential extraction tool for UNG220Z (Unionman China Mobile optical modem). It can only be used on your own device to retrieve forgotten management passwords, migrate broadband configurations, or perform security self-checks.

items.summary_vi: Cheng Tan Feng, một cá nhân có địa chỉ tại Singapore, vừa chi ra hơn trăm tỷ để tăng sở hữu tại CAEX, công ty tài sản số liên quan VPBank.
items.summary_en: Cheng Tan Feng, an individual with an address in Singapore, has just spent more than a hundred billion to increase his ownership in CAEX, a digital asset company related to VPBank.
